dct_description_sm: This project focused on the communication of climate change knowledge and the importance of education and community involvement in adaptation planning in the Canadian Arctic.  The objectives of this project were: (1) to ensure that Inuit communities have access to relevant and important climate change information; and (2) to provide a report that may serve as a foundation document in ensuring that climate change information is reaching Inuit communities, as well as relevant policy makers and community planners.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Information sharing
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
dct_title_s: Climate Change Communication to Inuit Assessment
